notes: METADATA_ONLY: no advisory prose vendored; this module only reads admitted metadata and cached payloads and writes its own report.

Cached GitHub advisory payloads in work/sources/_api_cache have no OSV `references` array, so commit/PR URLs were harvested from the cached advisory description as a documented fallback; every URL recorded here was read from disk.
A 40-hex commit URL replaces the tag-derived SHA (basis=osv_reference_commit). A PR URL alone records pr_number with basis=osv_reference_pr and RETAINS the tag-derived SHA - no SHA is invented.

No candidate/admitted/invariants/PRESENT/benchmark files are written by this module; markdown.py derives severity_reconciliation from the admitted data with these same upgrade helpers, so reruns are idempotent.
